sentences.en: Introverts need solitude to recover from having to work with extroverts.
sentences.zh: 内向的人需要独处来恢复精力，因为他们总是要和外向的人打交道。

sentences.en: Extroverts have this strong need to always be around other people.
sentences.zh: 外向的人总有一种强烈的需要，总是希望待在别人身边。

sentences.en: Do introverts not live as long as extroverts?
sentences.zh: 内向的人的寿命不比外向的人短吧？

senses.zh: 性格外向的人 活跃、愉快、爱交际的人
